title: 第7章 遭遇第8章 青阳第9章 寒月
content_zh:
叮铃——
清脆的驼铃声在山谷间回荡，许星遥抬头望去，只见官道尽头缓缓行来一队气派的商旅。
十二匹青鳞驼兽踏着整齐的步伐，每只驼兽脖颈上都挂着青铜铃铛，背上驮着沉甸甸的檀木货箱。
队伍中央的驼轿格外华丽，轿顶插着面青底金纹的旗帜，上面青阳林氏四个大字在阳光下熠熠生辉。
咦？这驼轿上的纹饰……许星遥眯起眼睛，突然看见驼轿帘子一掀，探出个熟悉的脑袋。
许师弟！
那人也看到了许星遥，瞬间眼睛一亮，直接一个鹞子翻身从三丈高的驼轿上跳了下来，锦缎衣袍在风中猎猎作响，腰间阴阳鱼玉佩叮咚相撞。
许星遥忍不住笑了：林师兄，你这出场还是这么清新脱俗。
林澈稳稳落地，掸了掸并不存在的灰尘，咧嘴笑道：这不是看见你高兴嘛！
他上下打量着许星遥，啧啧，才半月不见，怎么混得跟个逃荒的似的？
确实，此刻的许星遥衣衫褴褛，左臂衣袖上还有干涸的血迹。
他在青霖镇唯独忘了卖身新衣服，现在活像个落魄的散修。
他故意板起脸：林大少爷这是嫌弃师弟我了？
哪能啊！
林澈一把揽住许星遥的肩膀，走，上我轿子说话！
我这可有上好的云雾灵茶
驼轿内别有洞天。
地上铺着雪白的貂皮垫，小几上摆着几样精致点心和一壶冒着热气的灵茶。
许星遥刚坐下，就忍不住捏了块翡翠色的糕点塞进嘴里。
慢点吃，没人跟你抢。

林澈笑着给他斟茶，你这是去哪祸害人家灵田了？
许星遥边吃边含糊道：什么叫祸害？我这是正经游历！
去了青霖原采赤阳花，又到落星涧找了剑心兰……他滔滔不绝地讲起见闻，只是避开了矿洞和魔气那段。
等等！
林澈突然瞪大眼睛，你去落星涧居然没叫我？那儿的剑心兰可是我林家药园怎么也培育不出来的灵植！
谁让你回家享福去了？许星遥翻了个白眼，话说你怎么突然回族里了？该不会是相亲吧？
林澈一口茶喷了出来：相什么亲！
我是回去参加我妹的生辰礼！
他擦了擦嘴角，那小妮子非说要是我不回去，就把我藏在床底下的秋宫图交给我爹。
噗——这次轮到许星遥喷茶了，你还有这爱好？
两人笑闹间，话题不知怎么转到了神鹰族身上。
你是不知道，上个月神鹰族那个鹰扬长老来我们林家。
林澈捏着嗓子学起来，我们神鹰族乃太始正统，你们这些小家族要懂得分寸。
我呸！
不就是仗着现在掌着宗主之位嘛！
许星遥也来了兴致：可不是！
上次我去交宗门任务，有个神鹰族的内门弟子非要插队，说什么鹰击长空，万物皆在下
哈哈哈！
放屁！
林澈拍着大腿，那你怎么回的？

我说...许星遥清了清嗓子，学着那人的腔调，鹰击长空是不错，可别摔下来变成走地鸡
两人笑得前仰后合，林澈差点从坐垫上滚下去。
两人正闹得欢，驼轿帘子突然被掀开，一张严肃的方脸探了进来。
澈儿！
content_en:
Ding bell——
The crisp sound of camel bells echoed in the valley. Xu Xingyao looked up and saw a group of impressive business travelers slowly walking towards the end of the official road.
Twelve green-scaled camel beasts walked in neat steps. Each camel beast had a bronze bell hanging on its neck and carried a heavy sandalwood cargo box on its back.
The camel sedan in the center of the procession was particularly gorgeous, with a blue-and-gold-patterned flag on the top of the sedan, with the four characters "Qingyang Lin" shining brightly in the sun.
Huh? The decorations on this camel sedan... Xu Xingyao squinted his eyes, and suddenly saw the curtain of the camel sedan lifted, and a familiar head poked out.
Junior Brother Xu!
The man also saw Xu Xingyao, his eyes lit up instantly, and he turned over and jumped off the three-foot-high camel sedan. His brocade robes rustled in the wind, and the yin and yang fish and jade pendants around his waist jingled.
Xu Xingyao couldn't help but laugh: Senior Brother Lin, your appearance is still so fresh and refined.
Lin Che landed firmly on the ground, dusted off the non-existent dust, grinned and said: Isn't this why I am happy to see you?
He looked Xu Xingyao up and down, tut, he hadn't seen him for only half a month, how could he act like a fugitive?
Indeed, Xu Xingyao's clothes were in tatters at this moment, and there was dried blood on the sleeve of his left arm.
He only forgot to sell his new clothes in Qinglin Town, and now he looks like a down-and-out casual cultivator.
He deliberately kept a serious face: Master Lin, do you dislike me, your junior brother?
How can it be!
Lin Che put her arm around Xu Xingyao's shoulders and said, "Come on, get on my sedan chair and talk!"
I have the best Yunwu Ling tea here
There is a cave inside the camel sedan.
The floor was covered with snow-white mink fur mats, and there were several exquisite snacks and a pot of steaming spiritual tea on the small table.
As soon as Xu Xingyao sat down, he couldn't help but pinch a piece of emerald pastry and stuff it into his mouth.
Eat slowly, no one will compete with you.
Lin Che smiled and poured him tea. Where did you go to harm other people's spiritual fields?
Xu Xingyao said vaguely while eating: What is disaster? I am seriously traveling!
He went to Qinglin Plains to collect red sunflowers, and then went to Luo Xing Stream to find Jian Xin Lan... He talked endlessly about his experiences, but avoided the part about the mines and the demonic energy.
etc!
Lin Che's eyes suddenly widened, you went to Luo Xing Stream and you didn't call me? The sword heart orchid there is a spiritual plant that my Lin Family Medicine Garden cannot cultivate!
Who told you to go home and enjoy your happiness? Xu Xingyao rolled his eyes and asked, why did you suddenly return to the clan? Could it be a blind date?
Lin Che spat out a sip of tea: What kind of blind date is this?
I'm going back to attend my sister's birthday!
He wiped the corner of his mouth, and that little girl insisted that if I didn't go back, she would give my father the Autumn Palace Picture I hid under the bed.
Pfft - this time it's Xu Xingyao's turn to spray tea. Do you still have this hobby?
While the two were laughing and joking, the topic somehow turned to the Condor Clan.
You don’t know that last month Elder Ying Yang of the Divine Eagle Clan came to our Lin family.
Lin Che pinched her throat and learned, our Condor Clan is Taishi's orthodoxy, you small families must know how to measure.
Bah!
Isn't it just because he is now in charge of the position of the sect leader?
Xu Xingyao also became interested: No!
Last time I went to hand in a sect mission, there was an inner disciple of the Divine Eagle Clan who insisted on jumping in line, saying that if an eagle strikes the sky, everything will fall.
Hahaha!
fart!
Lin Che patted her thigh, then what did you do?
I said...Xu Xingyao cleared his throat and imitated that person's accent. It's good for an eagle to fly into the sky, but don't fall down and become a free-roaming chicken.
The two of them laughed so hard that Lin Che almost rolled off the seat.
The two were having fun when the curtain of the camel sedan was suddenly opened, and a serious square face poked in.
Cheer!
